clipping_formula: lower = max(0.0, y_hat - half_width); upper = y_hat + half_width
citation: Angelopoulos & Bates (2021), A Gentle Introduction to Conformal Prediction and Distribution-Free Uncertainty Quantification, https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.07511
limitations: Conformal-style chronological residual calibration; not proof of IID/exchangeable or distribution-free time-series coverage. Common market shocks, regime shifts and changing fold-specific model fits limit theoretical coverage guarantees. Reported intervals reflect empirical out-of-sample performance under retrospective availability assumptions.
